title: Confirm uniform re-addressing acceptance with green validate and a tree-wide legacy-address grep
description:
Close out the story's three acceptance criteria now that the doc/CLI-help hygiene sweep has landed and the epic's upstream stories (kind-segmented parser, label-value grammar widening, rule/gate item kinds, and the `invariants.toml` `enforced-by` rebind) are already complete. This task adds no new implementation — it produces the acceptance evidence the story's [hard] criteria are checked against, and fixes any remaining stray legacy-form reference the tree-wide grep turns up that the doc sweep and CLI-help fix did not already cover (for example an overlooked test fixture or comment).

Steps and evidence to capture:
1. Confirm all five kinds resolve under the uniform scheme and bare `satisfies:` labels are unaffected: run `jit item show @/invariant/INV-01 --json`, and `jit item list --kind requirement|decision|risk|definition --json`, plus `jit item show <short-id>/REQ-01 --json` (sugar form) for a live requirement in this repo; capture output. Separately confirm no qualified-form `satisfies:` label exists in live data — the investigation's confirmed baseline is 86 bare `satisfies:REQ-NN` occurrences and zero qualified-form ones (`dev/active/2821e177-investigation.md` REQ-08 finding); re-verify this count is unchanged.
2. Run `jit validate` (or `./scripts/jit-validate.sh`) and confirm a clean/green exit.
3. Run the tree-wide legacy-address grep across source, `.jit/` data, docs, and test fixtures: `grep -rn '@/[A-Z]' --include='*.rs' --include='*.md' --include='*.toml' --include='*.json' .` (excluding `.git/`, `target/`, and `.jit/gate-runs/`, which are immutable historical gate-run transcripts, not authored documentation). Confirm the only remaining matches are: (a) `<short-id>/<self-id>` sugar-form examples (explicitly not legacy per the story), and (b) this epic's own planning/decision-record and process/evidence artifacts (`dev/active/*-breakdown-spec.md`, `dev/active/2821e177-investigation.md`, `dev/active/2821e177-2d2d-4b25-b64a-4f38723e7fe6-plan.md`, the epic's design brief `dev/studies/addressing-v2-rule-gate-items.md` — whose open-point phrasing task c01f66dd deliberately preserved while annotating it resolved — and this task's own evidence file `dev/active/637764ef-acceptance-evidence.md`, which necessarily quotes the matches it documents) that quote the legacy form verbatim while describing decision D11 or the migration itself — these are process records of the migration, not user-facing documentation, and are left unedited; and (c) historical issue-description text in `.jit/issues/*.json` that quotes the legacy form as background for this epic's own completed work — issue descriptions are scope-defining records, and rewriting done issues' text would misrepresent the historical ask. Fix any other hit the grep surfaces (e.g. in `.rs` test fixtures) before closing this task. (Amendment A-637764ef, invoker-approved 2026-07-04: exception classes (b) extended and (c) added after the sweep surfaced these categories.)
4. Record, in this task's completion note, the scope decision for `dev/archive/**` (e.g. `dev/archive/features/25064508/showcase/talk.html`, a presentation deck about the already-shipped, already-archived feature, which shows literal `@/INV-01` examples): treat archived/frozen historical artifacts the same as the archived completion report the investigation classifies as "documentation hygiene, not a correctness requirement" (`dev/active/2821e177-investigation.md` REQ-08 finding) — out of scope, left as a historical snapshot, unless review disagrees.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: all five kinds (invariant, requirement, decision, risk, definition) resolve under `@[<project>]/<kind>/<self-id>` or the issue-scope sugar, demonstrated by the captured `jit item show`/`list` output from step 1; the re-verified bare-vs-qualified `satisfies:` count from step 1 is attached as evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: `jit validate` (or `./scripts/jit-validate.sh`) exits clean; the captured output from step 2 is attached as evidence.
- [hard] REQ-03: the tree-wide grep from step 3 shows no kindless `@/<self-id>` legacy address remaining outside the named exception classes from step 3 (sugar-form examples; this epic's own planning/decision-record and process/evidence artifacts, including the design brief and this task's evidence file; and historical issue-description text in `.jit/issues/*.json` — per amendment A-637764ef); any other hit is fixed before this task closes, and the `dev/archive/**` scope decision from step 4 is recorded. Elimination of colon-prefixed rule ids is produced and verified by the upstream rule-identity rename work with its own literal-pattern grep; this task's grep neither detects nor re-verifies that class.
